query: How do I pay for charging fees using a credit card?

expected.sourceQuestion: 如何使用信用卡支付充電費用?
requiredFacts: Complete credit-card payment verification in the CEM App before charging.
CEM places a MOP 800 pre-authorisation hold; it temporarily freezes credit limit and is not the final charge.
After charging, only the actual charging fee is charged and the hold is normally released immediately.
If pre-authorisation succeeds but charging does not start, the issuing bank generally releases the hold within 7–30 days.
Release timing varies by issuer; the customer should contact the card issuer when necessary.
expected.recommendedAnswer: To pay EV charging fees by credit card, first complete credit-card payment verification in the CEM App. CEM will then place a MOP 800 pre-authorisation hold on your card; this temporarily freezes part of your credit limit and is not the final charge. After charging is completed, only the actual charging fee will be charged, and the hold is normally released immediately. If pre-authorisation succeeds but charging does not start, the issuing bank will generally release the hold automatically within 7–30 days. The exact timing depends on the bank, so please contact your card issuer if necessary.

actual.answer:
You can pay for EV charging fees with a credit card in the following ways:

- One-off payment using Visa, Mastercard, or UnionPay credit cards.
- UnionPay contactless payment: first bind your UnionPay credit card on the UnionPay contactless payment page in the CEM App. Before charging, select UnionPay contactless payment as your payment method. When the charging session finishes, the system will automatically deduct the charging fee from your bound UnionPay credit card.
supportedButOffTargetFacts: Visa, Mastercard, and UnionPay support one-off charging payments.
UnionPay contactless payment is available as a separate payment mode.
missingFacts: 7–30 day release after charging fails to start

complete credit-card payment answer including the 7–30 day release window
release timing when charging does not start after pre-authorisation
